topic: Sanji breaks his legs-only rule against Wanze in chapter 370 by calling the train kitchen a kitchen
title: Sanji's Kitchen Loophole Beat Wanze's Ramen Armor
description: Sanji's legs only rule has one loophole, and chapter 370 shows exactly how he uses it against the CP7 chef Wanze on the Puffing Tom. Is Sanji's rule a limit or a choice?
comment: Is Sanji's legs only rule a real limit, or a choice he can drop whenever he wants?

lines.text: Sanji's legs only rule has one loophole, and it's a kitchen.

shot.fallback: cook facing a noodle-armored chef on a train

lines.text: Chapter 370. Sanji meets Wanze, a CP7 chef on the Puffing Tom.

shot.fallback: grinning chef in noodle armor on a train

lines.text: Wanze makes ramen armor, and a kick would just get stuck in it.
For Sanji that's a real problem. Hands are for cooking, so his whole style is legs only.

shot.fallback: cook mid-kick in a black suit

lines.text: So he pulls out knives and says he's in a kitchen, and he's cutting up food.

shot.fallback: cook slicing noodle armor with kitchen knives

lines.text: Rule bypassed. Armor gone. Wanze goes flying through the cars.

shot.search: Sanji kicks Wanze through train cars
shot.fallback: cook kicking a chef down a train

lines.text: Here's the detail most people forgot. The wiki notes that knife work is tied to Sanji's distant past.

shot.fallback: cook holding a knife in thought

lines.text: I think the rule was never a limit. It's a choice, and he picks the loophole the moment food is on the line.

shot.fallback: cook stirring a pot with fierce focus

lines.text: Look at Whole Cake Island. Bobbin takes a bite of his bento, and Sanji kicks him into a wall at once.

shot.fallback: cook kicking a guard over a lunch box

lines.text: So what is that choice protecting him from?
Because Sanji's legs only rule has one loophole...

shot.fallback: cook in a kitchen at night

self_check.hook: Contrarian claim: Sanji's rule has a loophole, in 10 words, named character first
self_check.loop: Final line starts the same sentence as line 1, so it flows back into it
